problem.title: The gap is execution, not listings
problem.lead: Jobs are already out there. What stalls people is the path from finding a role to sending the application.
problem.fragmentedBody: Search, enhance, tailor, apply, and track live in 8–12 tools. Every hop means starting over.
problem.switchingBody: Each node means repasting data, re-matching the JD, and opening another tab. Time goes to moving, not deciding.
problem.qualityBody: Under time pressure, tailoring and apply quality drop. The same resume produces shaky output when rushed.

how.title: The journey in one product
how.lead: Stay in one place: match, enhance the master CV, tailor to the JD, confirm apply, then track.
